t.E466.agn: In 2018 EFSA saw no need for a numerical acceptable daily intake (ADI) and found no safety concern at the reported use levels.
t.E466.body: Celluloses are not absorbed and are largely excreted unchanged in faeces; part of them may be fermented by bacteria in the large intestine.
t.E466.prod: It is produced by treating cellulose with alkali and monochloroacetic acid.
t.E466.regx.0: Re-evaluated; no numerical ADI needed, no safety concern at the reported uses.
t.E466.summary: A thickener (CMC) produced from cellulose. It is used in ice cream, drinks, sauces and bakery products.
